    Sharing

    • proposals.list List share additions

    • proposals.deny Deny a share addition

    proposals.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals MCP proposals_list

    List share additions

    Records that recipients of this environment's edit shares added while their share needs your approval (role owner), and the ones you added from this environment to someone else's share (role proposer). status: pending (the default), approved, denied, withdrawn, or applied (added at once by a share that allows it). preview says what each one adds. Decide with proposals.approve or proposals.deny; set what a share allows in the app (Settings › Sharing).

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    statusenumOne of pending, approved, denied, applied, withdrawn.
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "pending",
        "approved",
        "denied",
        "applied",
        "withdrawn"
      ],
      "default": "pending"
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    proposals.approve write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals/{proposal}/approve MCP proposals_approve

    Approve a share addition

    Add a pending proposal's records to this environment, owned by you (cards get your next numbers). The recipient then sees them as ordinary shared records. Only the environment's owner can; a decided one is refused with 409 proposal_decided, and one that no longer fits its share (what it was added to is gone or no longer shared) with 409 proposal_out_of_scope.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    proposalstringrequiredProposal id (proposals.list).
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "proposal": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Proposal id (proposals.list)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "proposal"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    proposals.deny write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals/{proposal}/deny MCP proposals_deny

    Deny a share addition

    Turn down a pending proposal. Nothing is added; the recipient's pending copy disappears and they are told it was denied. A decided one is refused with 409 proposal_decided.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    proposalstringrequiredProposal id (proposals.list).

      "description": "Proposal id (proposals.list)."
